question: In March 2025, the Parliament passed the Banking Laws (Amendment) Bill. It amended the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934, and _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Banking Regulation Act, 1949**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Banking Laws (Amendment) Bill** was introduced to amend several key legislations governing the financial sector in India, primarily the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934** and the **Banking Regulation Act, 1949**.
 
• One of the most significant changes introduced by the bill is the provision for **multiple nominations**. Previously, depositors could only nominate **one individual** per account; the new amendment allows for up to **four nominees**, including the provision for successive and simultaneous nominations.
 
• The bill proposes to change the **reporting dates** for banks. Instead of the current system of reporting based on alternate **Fridays**, banks will now report their regulatory compliance data (like CRR and SLR) on the **15th and the last day of every month**.
